SELECT distinct a.QUESTION_ID as id ,IFNULL(a.QUESTION_RECTIFICATION_PLAN,'') as QUESTION_RECTIFICATION_PLAN ,IFNULL(z.QUESTION_TYPE_DSCR,'') AS QUESTION_TYPE_DSCR ,a.SORT as SORT ,IFNULL(a.QUESTION_DSCR,'') AS name ,ifnull(a.QUESTION_PID,'') as pid ,IFNULL(z.QUESTION_TYPE,'') AS QUESTION_TYPE ,IFNULL(a.QUESTION_DETAILS,'') AS QUESTION_DETAILS ,IFNULL(a.QUESTION_QUALITATIVE,'') AS QUESTION_QUALITATIVE ,IFNULL(a.QUESTION_OPINIONS,'') AS QUESTION_OPINIONS ,IFNULL(a.QUESTION_SEVERITY,'') AS QUESTION_SEVERITY ,a.PATH AS path ,a.isleaf as isleaf ,GROUP_CONCAT(IFNULL(c.RULE_FILE_CONTENT,'')) AS RULE_FILE_CONTENT FROM inspection.inspection_question_bank a LEFT JOIN inspection.inspection_question_bank d ON a.QUESTION_PID = d.QUESTION_ID LEFT JOIN inspection.inspection_question_rule_relation b ON a.QUESTION_ID = b.QUESTION_ID LEFT JOIN inspection.inspection_question_rule c ON b.RULE_ID = c.RULE_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT a.QUESTION_ID, GROUP_CONCAT(e.ENUM_DSCR) AS QUESTION_TYPE_DSCR, GROUP_CONCAT(e.ENUM_ID) AS QUESTION_TYPE FROM inspection.inspection_question_bank_type a, enumset.cm_guoku_enumeration e WHERE e.ENUM_TYPE_ID IN(12, 21) AND a.TYPE = e.ENUM_ID GROUP BY a.QUESTION_ID )z ON a.QUESTION_ID = z.QUESTION_ID GROUP BY a.sort, a.QUESTION_ID ,QUESTION_RECTIFICATION_PLAN ,a.SORT ,a.QUESTION_DSCR ,a.QUESTION_PID ,QUESTION_TYPE ,a.QUESTION_QUALITATIVE ,a.QUESTION_OPINIONS ,a.QUESTION_SEVERITY ,a.isleaf ORDER BY a.SORT
